metadata.grader: gpt-6.1-sol, medium reasoning effort, fresh separate sessions

protocol.method: Each arm received identical synthetic task and no-tool instruction in a fresh ephemeral read-only session. Treatment received the skill and resources; baseline was not supplied them. Host skill discovery was disabled. Event records showed no tool calls.
protocol.grading: Separate fresh same-model graders received randomly labeled responses and frozen criteria. Configuration labels were withheld but could be inferred from response content. Pass evidence is a verified verbatim substring; absence is stated for failures. Complete responses and redacted event streams accompany the grades. Grader model gpt-6.1-sol used medium reasoning effort.
